ulasan.Ulasan: Partner Brent Brehm and Amy, the intake Director, were so kind to provide me with the gift of their time, and encouragement for over 2 years. I appreciated being able to call them for guidance during this extremely difficult period of my life. I settled with the disability insurance company based on Brent's recommendation. I highly recommend Kantor & Kantor.
